name: cjk
note: css-text-3 §6.1 keep-all: a long CJK run under word-break:keep-all does not break at all — one overflowing line in both engines (the run loses its overflow fallback unless overflow-wrap re-allows). The Latin control shows keep-all leaves space-separated Latin wrapping untouched. Pure-CJK wrap COUNTS under word-break:normal are count-sensitive to CJK glyph fallback metrics, which differ between this engine's measurement surface and Chrome (see docs/ledgers/breakers.md) — the suppression semantics, not the counts, are the pin here. The CJK run's border box is a declared maskElement: the engine's registered face (Noto Sans) has no CJK glyphs, so Chrome's CJK ink is not reproducible; the keep-all geometry (one overflowing line) is what the rect layer pins.
